messages:
rachel: Heads up — big hygiene spike after last night's import. We're seeing ~12k unclaimed accounts and the unowned-nudge playbook started firing at ~02:12 UTC. Can we pause it and triage before more nudges go out?

linda: Ugh. Are renewals or trials in that set?

raman: Quick numbers: ~12,098 accounts unowned, ~150 trials with <30d to renewal. Query I ran: `SELECT count(*) FROM crm.accounts WHERE owner IS NULL AND imported_at >= '2026-03-22T00:00:00Z';` Playbook run id: `pb-run-202603220212` — status: running.

playbook-bot: playbook-runner: pb-run-202603220212 started at 2026-03-22T02:12:04Z, recipients: 12098, step: batch_send (45% complete).

carlos: Pause it now. Steps: 1) Pause rule from Admin UI (Admin -> Playbooks -> nudge-unowned -> Pause). 2) If you prefer CLI:
```
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/api/playbooks/pause \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -d '{"playbook_id":"nudge-unowned"}'
```
I'll flip the suppression flag for that import cohort after pause.

olivia: Also we should prepare a short apology + survey for anyone who already got the nudge. Draft: "Sorry — you may have received a message by mistake. We value your time; any feedback? [1-min survey link]" Keep it simple and only send to active trials.

rachel: Agreed. Two actionable asks: pause playbook, and run a gated backfill to claim owners where possible and to mark obvious duplicates for manual review. Backfill ratecap: 200/min, target window: next 2 hours. Exclude renewals <30d and accounts with `health_score >= 0.6` for now.

raman: I'll take the backfill. Plan: dry-run first on 500 accounts, then full gated run with `--rate=200` and safety checks. Dry-run command: `python tools/backfill_owners.py --cohort import-20260322 --limit 500 --dry-run`

linda: Who can draft the apology email and the suppression list? I can do the email copy, raman can produce suppression CSV. We'll need a short 15-min sync in 10 mins to confirm.

carlos: I'll flip the pause and push suppression CSV to S3 -> `s3://cs-ops/suppression/import-20260322.csv`. Also adding a safelist: accounts with `manual_owner=true` won't be touched.

olivia: For postmortem please include: root cause (import mapping mismatch), why playbook didn't dry-run, and a set of mitigations: dry-run default, cohort size threshold, rate limits, and a temporary manual approval for >5k recipients.

rachel: Perfect. After today's triage we'll update the playbook's config: add `cohort_threshold`, default `dry_run=true` for new playbooks, and add an allowlist for renewals. I'll document the action items in the CS runbook and ping stakeholders. :thumbsup:

playbook-bot: playbook-runner: pb-run-202603220212 paused by carlos at 2026-03-22T02:22:48Z. recipients_sent: 5,402.

rachel: Thanks everyone — quick huddle in 10. After that we'll embargo any outbound touches for the cohort until backfill + apology flow complete. I'll open a retrospective thread with logs & decision notes.

linda: Thanks — appreciate the quick responses.

raman: Starting dry-run now. Posting results in #customer-success in ~8 mins.
